items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: On the live show it’ll be Winard Harper and Jason [Marsalis] alternating – my little brother – Dezron Douglas on bass, Mark Gross on saxophone.

ctx.x: Who else are you working with on this production? It’s multi-media now. Who else are the key players?

Yeah, a director in New Orleans, John Grimsley. The libretto – not the libretto, but the book was compiled by Charles E. Gerber and myself and John Grimsley. Kenneth Brown, Jr., is going to be acting. On the live show it’ll be Winard Harper and Jason [Marsalis] alternating – my little brother – Dezron Douglas on bass, Mark Gross on saxophone. Don Byron is playing, and two of Branford’s former students, Lynn Grissett on trumpet and Shaena Ryan on bari sax. David Bryant on piano. Is that everybody? I think that’s…

is something that we can’t actually achieve. It’s just something that, it’s like in a museum. But these were guys that actually lived. This was an important part of their lives, and this is the information that they left for us. That’s it.
